infobox.usage: Unlocks a pickup truck at the sawmill on Woods.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Yotota car key (Yotota) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A Yotota folding car key with locking buttons.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the blue Yotota pickup truck next to the wooden shacks on Woods. Bug: The door is currently bugged and can't be unlocked.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
Easter eggs and References:
- The name "Yotota" is a reference of Toyota the vehicle brand.
- The vehicle key is modeled after the 2006-2010 Audi A6 key fob.
